verdict.rationale: Godot is released under the permissive MIT license. The official sources say there are 'no strings attached, no royalties, nothing', that it is free for any purpose including commercial and proprietary distribution, and that the license does not apply to your games, which you solely own. A community comment adds that, unlike Unity, there is no mandatory engine splash screen. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of per-install fees in the evidence, and no independent corroboration that the engine is royalty-free beyond the vendor's own statements.
